records.text: Theradrim Guardians are elemental wardens who knock down foes in combat and summon a Theradrim Shardling when they die.
Deep Borers are burrowing beasts.
Putridus Satyrs are satyr fighters who use Sinister Strike in combat.
Putridus Tricksters are satyrs that use Putrid Breath.
Putridus Shadowstalkers are satyrs who hamstring foes in combat.
Celebrian Dryads are hostile garden guardians who warn outsiders that their bodies will nourish the gardens’ creations and threaten to destroy anything they see as befouling them.
A hostile garden guardian warns intruders that they will nourish its creations and says nothing must befoul the gardens. In combat it uses Throw and Strike.

Princess Theradras is described as an elemental force of earth linked to the Old Gods. Her ancient relationship with Zaetar, Cenarius’s first son, is linked to the centaur’s origin. The centaur killed Zaetar, and Theradras is a target in efforts to recover his remains.
Landslide is a Maraudon combatant that uses Landslide and Knock Away in battle.
The Primordial Behemoth is a Maraudon combatant that uses Trample and Boulder in battle.
A Poison Sprite is a hostile demon found in the Blackwood area. It attacks with Poison Bolt.
The Corruptor is a hostile creature in the Blackwood area that uses Corruption and Noxious Catalyst against its foes.
The Vile Larva is a hostile beast found in the Blackwood area. It attacks with Larva Goo.
The Barbed Lasher is an elite hostile plant in the Blackwood area. It attacks with Thorn Volley.
The Constrictor Vine is an elite hostile plant in the Blackwood area. It attacks with Entangling Roots.
The Noxious Slime is a hostile ooze found in the Blackwood area. It attacks with Noxious Cloud.
Creeping Sludge is a sludge creature.
An elemental that lurks in the caverns, the Cavern Lurker uses Knockdown in combat.
An elemental cave shambler that uses Wild Regeneration and Knockdown in combat.
Celebras the Cursed is a named humanoid who fights with Wrath, Twisted Tranquility, Corrupt Forces of Nature, and Entangling Roots; on death, he can summon a creature.
Lord Vyletongue is a demon who dual-wields and shoots in combat.
Meshlok the Harvester is an elite creature. In combat, it repeatedly strikes its victim.

Zaetar's Spirit remains concerned for his centaur children despite condemning their crimes. He asks that his brother Remulos receive the Seed of Life and learn that Zaetar's spirit remains, carrying on through the life his remains nourished.
Maraudos is the spirit of the Fourth Kahn. A spell can manifest him, and he attacks with thrown weapons.
Veng is the spirit of the Fifth Kahn. A spell can manifest him, and he attacks with a bow.
Razorlash is a creature that casts Cleave during combat.
Deeprot Stomper is a creature that uses War Stomp and Strike during combat.
Deeprot Tangler is a creature that casts Entangling Roots during combat and Thorns out of combat.

Noxxion is a living symbol of the corruption Lord Vyletongue spread through Maraudon, dwelling beyond the orange crystals. Celebras says Noxxion and Vyletongue stole the two parts of his brother’s scepter. Noxxion’s known behavior is hostile: it uses Toxic Volley and Uppercut in combat.
A subterranean diemetradon of the caves around Maraudon, this beast attacks with Sonic Burst when in combat.
A spewed larva found in Maraudon, it uses Noxious Catalyst in combat.
Rotgrip is a hostile creature in Maraudon. Its attacks include Puncture and a Fatal Bite against badly wounded targets.
A stolid snapjaw found in Maraudon, it is a beast that hardens itself with Spikes while out of combat.
Tinkerer Gizlock claims to rule his domain and insists that no one reveal his presence. His words suggest he is hiding in Maraudon; he attacks intruders with a gun and bombs.

Celebras the Redeemed is a freed figure of Maraudon who remembers drifting in a cursed form. He seeks to restore his scepter and hopes its power will bring peace to his uncle’s spirit; after the ritual, he urges its wielder to use that power for good.
A corrupted elemental found in Maraudon.

Elder Splitrock is encountered in Maraudon. At the new year, Splitrock speaks of the bright moon and the ancients waking. The elder regards old battles as the seeds of legends and offers visitors a token with a blessing that their own legends take root and thrive.
